newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Finmin says may upgrade 97 growth outlook.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Finmin says may upgrade 97 growth outlook.

text.p: The Portuguese government could eventually revise its 1997 growth forecast upwards but the moment for a review had not yet arrived, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said on Wednesday.

"Everybody agrees an upwards revision would be reasonable. The Bank of Portugal already has a range between 3.0 and 3.75 percent and it stressed that a figure towards the top end was more likely," he said.
The economic convergence plan Portugal sent to the European Commission sees growth of 3.3 percent in 1997, up from some three percent last year.
"We will only make a revision when we have a concrete reason, probably when we...prepare the 1998 budget," he said.
